hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; uv run ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
hooks.statusMessage: ruff format on edited file (lint runs at Stop)

hooks.command: git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\.py$' || exit 0; uv run ruff check && uv run mypy && uv run pytest -q || exit 2
